stages.name: cilium-build
stages.expectedRUNNormalized:
set -eu && export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && cd /tmp/kubeview-os-medium && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS && plan="$(apt-get --simulate --no-download --no-install-recommends --only-upgrade --no-remove install /tmp/kubeview-os-medium/libpcre2-8-0_10.46-1ubuntu0.1_arm64.deb /tmp/kubeview-os-medium/zlib1g_1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1ubuntu3.2_arm64.deb)" && printf '%s
' "$plan" && printf '%s
' "$plan" | while IFS=' ' read -r action package rest; do if [ "$action" = Inst ]; then case "${package%%:*}" in libpcre2-8-0|zlib1g) ;; *) printf 'Unexpected package change: %s
' "$package" >&2; exit 81 ;; esac; elif [ "$action" = Remv ]; then exit 82; fi; done && apt-get -y --no-install-recommends --only-upgrade --no-remove install /tmp/kubeview-os-medium/libpcre2-8-0_10.46-1ubuntu0.1_arm64.deb /tmp/kubeview-os-medium/zlib1g_1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1ubuntu3.2_arm64.deb && test "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' libpcre2-8-0)" = '10.46-1ubuntu0.1' && test "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' zlib1g)" = '1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1ubuntu3.2' && cd / && rm -rf /tmp/kubeview-os-medium /var/lib/apt/lists/* /var/cache/apt/archives/*.deb
